source.title: Common English words chosen for each age group (starter list). Meanings and sentences are original to this project.
source.license: Reference only (the page describes the kind of list this was modelled on). No list was copied: words, meanings and sentences were written for this project and are released with it.

words.meaning: spoke, like when you tell someone something
words.sentence: Mum said it is time for tea.

words.meaning: the past of 'are'
words.sentence: We were at the park all day.

words.meaning: a word for more than one person you are talking about
words.sentence: They went to the shops.

words.meaning: to move toward the person who is speaking
words.sentence: Please come and sit with us.

words.meaning: a few, but not all
words.sentence: I would like some milk.

words.meaning: to move on your feet at a slow pace
words.sentence: We walk to school each day.
words.tip: There is a silent 'l' in the middle.

words.meaning: to say words to someone
words.sentence: Let us talk about your day.
words.tip: There is a silent 'l' in the middle.

words.meaning: to wish to have something
words.sentence: I want a drink of water.

words.meaning: to hand something to someone to keep
words.sentence: Please give me the pencil.

words.meaning: to have your home somewhere
words.sentence: Where do you live?

words.meaning: a word that tells the reason for something
words.sentence: I wore a coat because it was cold.
words.tip: Big Elephants Can Always Understand Small Elephants.

words.meaning: someone you like and enjoy being with
words.sentence: My friend came to play.
words.tip: You find a fri-END at the end.

words.meaning: men, women and children
words.sentence: Many people were at the market.

words.meaning: a place where children go to learn
words.sentence: We learn to read at school.

words.meaning: a word used to say what could happen or what you want
words.sentence: I would like some juice.

words.meaning: a word that says you were able to
words.sentence: I could see the moon last night.

words.meaning: a word that says what is the right thing to do
words.sentence: You should brush your teeth.

words.meaning: one more time
words.sentence: Please read the story again.

words.meaning: every time, without ever stopping
words.sentence: The sun always rises in the morning.

words.meaning: each one of a group
words.sentence: I brush my teeth every day.

words.meaning: very pretty to look at
words.sentence: The garden looks beautiful in spring.
words.tip: Big Elephants Always Understand Things If Fed Up Lunches.

words.meaning: with each other, not alone
words.sentence: We played together all afternoon.

words.meaning: one more, or a different one
words.sentence: May I have another slice of bread?

words.meaning: had an idea or an opinion in your mind
words.sentence: I thought it would rain today.

words.meaning: as much as you need
words.sentence: We have enough chairs for everyone.

words.meaning: the day before today
words.sentence: We went to the zoo yesterday.

words.meaning: you hold it over your head to stay dry in the rain
words.sentence: Take an umbrella, it might rain.

words.meaning: something that matters a lot
words.sentence: It is important to drink water.

words.meaning: what you say or write when someone asks a question
words.sentence: Do you know the answer?
words.tip: There is a silent 'w' in the middle.

words.meaning: having a lot to do
words.sentence: Dad is busy cooking dinner.
